verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's developer docs say users can connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code or another MCP client to check their calendar, find open times, book meetings and manage links from a chat. That is first-party support for natural-language operation, but it rests on a single brief mention and depends on an external AI client rather than a native in-product natural-language interface. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the MCP/chat integration (setup, supported tools and limits), a native in-app natural-language command interface, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, or another MCP client to check your calendar, find open times, book meetings, and manage your links from a chat.
